changelog: 🚀 KiberIz v14.5.0: 9 ta to'liq kiber-ikonkalar to'plami va har bir ikonka uchun individual jonli ochilish (Launch Logo) animatsiyasi! Yangi ikonkalar: 🧊 Frostbite Glacier (Kriogen Muz Qalqon) va 💎 Billura Crystal Romance (Billur Romantika). To'liq to'plam: 🦅 Falcon (Lochin), 🛡️ Classic (Qalqon), 🐺 Cyber Wolf (Ko‘k Bo‘ri), 🟢 Matrix Cyber-Stealth (Hacker), 🤍 Titanium Minimalist (Apple Style), 👑 Imperial Gold (VIP Elita), 🌸 Sakura Blossom (Romantik), 🧊 Frostbite Glacier (Kriogen Muz) va 💎 Billura Crystal Romance (Billur Romantika). Ilova ochilganda tanlangan ikonkaning logosi, o'ziga xos aurasimon neon nuri, 3D shimmer effekti va mos subtitri bilan chiroyli animatsiya bo'lib chiqadi.
